# Overview

This document reproduces the two Google Earth Engine (GEE) scripts used in
the study, with their full code. The code chunks are identical to the
standalone files in the repository's `gee/` folder:

| Script | Purpose | Output |
|---|---|---|
| `01_landsat_composites.js` | Annual 3-year dry-season medoid composites, 2000–2019, with spectral indices, texture and terrain bands | 20 GeoTIFFs (Google Drive folder `GEE_Ghana_Mining_Medoid`) |
| `02_export_training_samples.js` | Reference layers for manual labelling, and export of the labelled points | CSVs (Google Drive folder `GEE_Manual_Sampling`) and GEE table assets |

The composites and the training points are the inputs to the R analysis
(random forest classification, spatially blocked cross-validation, backward
transition rules and Monte Carlo uncertainty). See `gee/README.md` for the
band table, asset requirements and output column definitions.

**To run the code**, open the GEE Code Editor
(<https://code.earthengine.google.com>), paste the complete script into a new
file, change the asset paths under `projects/XXX/assets/` to
your own project, click **Run**, and start the export tasks in the **Tasks**
tab. The chunks of each script below, taken in order, form the complete file.

Citation: Bräuer, H. (TODO year). Quantification of Ghana's historical mining
expansion. *GIScience & Remote Sensing*. <https://doi.org/TODO>

# Script 1: Landsat composites (`01_landsat_composites.js`)

**Summary of the method**

- **Study area:** 2019 mining polygons buffered by 5 km; images filtered to
  Ghana; export cropped to the bounding box of the buffered area.
- **Temporal window:** for target year *t*, dry-season scenes (1 November to
  30 April) from the seasons ending in *t*−1, *t* and *t*+1.
- **Pre-processing:** scenes with < 50 % cloud cover; `QA_PIXEL` masking of
  cloud, shadow and snow (and cirrus for OLI) at medium or high confidence;
  Landsat 7 SLC-off gaps masked; Collection 2 Level-2 scaling.
- **Cross-sensor harmonization:** OLI to ETM+ after Roy et al. (2016).
- **Compositing:** medoid (Flood, 2013).
- **Features:** 6 reflectance bands, 12 spectral indices, 5 NIR texture
  metrics and 4 terrain variables (the 27 classifier features), plus
  night-light, quality and NDVI-anomaly bands that are exported but not used
  in the classifier.
- **Output:** EPSG:32630 (UTM 30N), 30 m, cloud-optimized GeoTIFF.

### Script header

```{js, eval=FALSE}
// ===============================================================
// GHANA MINING COMPOSITE
// Addressing: 3-year dry-season, Medoid, Harmonization, Literature-Endorsed Indices
// ===============================================================

// Define Landsat collections
var L5_COLLECTION = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2');
var L7_COLLECTION = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LE07/C02/T1_L2');
var L8_COLLECTION = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2');
var L9_COLLECTION = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2');

// Get SRTM elevation data
var SRTM_ELEVATION = ee.Image('USGS/SRTMGL1_003');

// Nightlight data collections
var VIIRS_DNB = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG');
var DMSP_OLS = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/DMSP-OLS/NIGHTTIME_LIGHTS');
```

### Landsat scaling (Collection 2 Level 2)

```{js, eval=FALSE}
// ===============================================================
// LANDSAT SCALING (Collection 2 Level 2)
// Reference: USGS (2022)
// ===============================================================

function applyScaleFactorsL5L7(image) {
  var opticalBands = image.select('SR_B.')
    .multiply(0.0000275)
    .add(-0.2)
    .clamp(0, 1);
    
  return image.addBands(opticalBands, null, true)
    .select(
      ['SR_B1', 'SR_B2', 'SR_B3', 'SR_B4', 'SR_B5', 'SR_B7'],
      ['BLUE', 'GREEN', 'RED', 'NIR', 'SWIR1', 'SWIR2']
    ).toFloat();
}

function applyScaleFactorsL8L9(image) {
  var opticalBands = image.select('SR_B.')
    .multiply(0.0000275)
    .add(-0.2)
    .clamp(0, 1);
    
  return image.addBands(opticalBands, null, true)
    .select(
      ['SR_B2', 'SR_B3', 'SR_B4', 'SR_B5', 'SR_B6', 'SR_B7'],
      ['BLUE', 'GREEN', 'RED', 'NIR', 'SWIR1', 'SWIR2']
    ).toFloat();
}
```

### Cross-sensor harmonization (Roy et al. 2016)

```{js, eval=FALSE}
// ===============================================================
// CROSS-SENSOR HARMONIZATION (Roy et al. 2016)
// Transforms OLI (L8/9) to ETM+ (L7) spectral space
// ===============================================================

function harmonizeOLItoETM(image) {
  // Coefficients from Roy et al. (2016) Table 2
  // OLI = slope * ETM + intercept -> ETM = (OLI - intercept) / slope
  // For consistency, we transform OLI TO ETM+ reference
  var coefficients = {
    BLUE:  {slope: 0.8850, intercept: 0.0183},
    GREEN: {slope: 0.9317, intercept: 0.0123},
    RED:   {slope: 0.9372, intercept: 0.0123},
    NIR:   {slope: 0.8339, intercept: 0.0448},
    SWIR1: {slope: 0.8639, intercept: 0.0306},
    SWIR2: {slope: 0.9165, intercept: 0.0116}
  };
  
  var harmonized = image
    .select('BLUE').subtract(coefficients.BLUE.intercept).divide(coefficients.BLUE.slope).rename('BLUE')
    .addBands(image.select('GREEN').subtract(coefficients.GREEN.intercept).divide(coefficients.GREEN.slope).rename('GREEN'))
    .addBands(image.select('RED').subtract(coefficients.RED.intercept).divide(coefficients.RED.slope).rename('RED'))
    .addBands(image.select('NIR').subtract(coefficients.NIR.intercept).divide(coefficients.NIR.slope).rename('NIR'))
    .addBands(image.select('SWIR1').subtract(coefficients.SWIR1.intercept).divide(coefficients.SWIR1.slope).rename('SWIR1'))
    .addBands(image.select('SWIR2').subtract(coefficients.SWIR2.intercept).divide(coefficients.SWIR2.slope).rename('SWIR2'));
  
  return harmonized.copyProperties(image, image.propertyNames());
}
```

### Cloud masking with confidence levels

```{js, eval=FALSE}
// ===============================================================
// ENHANCED CLOUD MASKING WITH CONFIDENCE LEVELS
// Reference: USGS Landsat Collection 2 QA Band Specification
// ===============================================================

// Confidence level constants
var CONFIDENCE = {
  LOW: 1,      // Bit pattern: 01
  MEDIUM: 2,   // Bit pattern: 10
  HIGH: 3      // Bit pattern: 11
};

// Configurable threshold (set to MEDIUM to mask medium + high confidence)
var CLOUD_CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD = CONFIDENCE.MEDIUM;
var SHADOW_CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD = CONFIDENCE.MEDIUM;

function maskCloudsL457Enhanced(image) {
  var qa = image.select('QA_PIXEL');
  
  // Basic flags (bits 3-5)
  var cloudBit = 1 << 3;
  var shadowBit = 1 << 4;
  var snowBit = 1 << 5;
  
  // Extract confidence levels (2-bit values)
  // Cloud confidence: bits 8-9
  var cloudConfidence = qa.rightShift(8).bitwiseAnd(3);
  // Shadow confidence: bits 10-11
  var shadowConfidence = qa.rightShift(10).bitwiseAnd(3);
  
  // Create masks
  // Option A: Mask if flag is set AND confidence >= threshold
  var cloudMask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBit).eq(0)
    .or(cloudConfidence.lt(CLOUD_CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD));
  
  var shadowMask = qa.bitwiseAnd(shadowBit).eq(0)
    .or(shadowConfidence.lt(SHADOW_CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD));
  
  var snowMask = qa.bitwiseAnd(snowBit).eq(0);
  
  // Combine all masks
  var combinedMask = cloudMask.and(shadowMask).and(snowMask);
  
  // Optional: Add a confidence band for quality assessment
  var qualityScore = ee.Image.constant(3)
    .subtract(cloudConfidence.max(shadowConfidence))
    .rename('CLOUD_CONFIDENCE');
  
  return image.updateMask(combinedMask)
    .addBands(qualityScore);
}

function maskCloudsL89Enhanced(image) {
  var qa = image.select('QA_PIXEL');
  
  // Basic flags
  var cloudBit = 1 << 3;
  var shadowBit = 1 << 4;
  var snowBit = 1 << 5;
  var cirrusBit = 1 << 2;
  
  // Confidence levels
  var cloudConfidence = qa.rightShift(8).bitwiseAnd(3);
  var shadowConfidence = qa.rightShift(10).bitwiseAnd(3);
  var cirrusConfidence = qa.rightShift(14).bitwiseAnd(3);  // Bits 14-15 for cirrus
  
  // Masks with confidence thresholds
  var cloudMask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBit).eq(0)
    .or(cloudConfidence.lt(CLOUD_CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD));
  
  var shadowMask = qa.bitwiseAnd(shadowBit).eq(0)
    .or(shadowConfidence.lt(SHADOW_CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD));
  
  var snowMask = qa.bitwiseAnd(snowBit).eq(0);
  
  var cirrusMask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBit).eq(0)
    .or(cirrusConfidence.lt(CONFIDENCE.MEDIUM));
  
  var combinedMask = cloudMask.and(shadowMask).and(snowMask).and(cirrusMask);
  
  // Quality score (higher = more confident it's clear)
  var maxContamination = cloudConfidence.max(shadowConfidence).max(cirrusConfidence);
  var qualityScore = ee.Image.constant(3)
    .subtract(maxContamination)
    .rename('CLOUD_CONFIDENCE');
  
  return image.updateMask(combinedMask)
    .addBands(qualityScore);
}
```

### Medoid compositing (Flood 2013)

```{js, eval=FALSE}
// ===============================================================
// MEDOID COMPOSITING (Flood 2013)
// Selects the actual observation closest to the multi-dimensional median
// ===============================================================

function calculateMedoid(collection, bands) {
  var median = collection.select(bands).median();
  
  var withDistance = collection.map(function(image) {
    var diff = image.select(bands).subtract(median);
    var distance = diff.pow(2).reduce(ee.Reducer.sum()).sqrt();
    // MULTIPLY BY -1 so qualityMosaic picks MINIMUM distance
    return image.addBands(distance.multiply(-1).rename('quality'));
  });
  
  var medoid = withDistance.qualityMosaic('quality');
  return medoid.select(bands);
}

// Add valid pixel count:
function addValidPixelCount(collection, bands) {
  // Count valid (non-masked) pixels per location
  var validCount = collection.select(bands[0]).map(function(img) {
    return img.mask();  // 1 where valid, 0 where masked
  }).reduce(ee.Reducer.sum()).rename('VALID_PIXEL_COUNT');
  
  return validCount;
}
```

### Landsat 7 processing with explicit SLC-off masking

```{js, eval=FALSE}
// ===============================================================
// ENHANCED LANDSAT 7 PROCESSING WITH EXPLICIT SLC-OFF MASKING
// ===============================================================

function processL7(image) {
  // 1. Cloud masking
  var cloudMasked = maskCloudsL457Enhanced(image);
  
  // 2. SLC-off gap masking (explicit)
  var blue = cloudMasked.select('SR_B1');
  var validMask = blue.gt(0);  // Quick check - gaps are 0 or null
  var slcMasked = cloudMasked.updateMask(validMask);
  
  // 3. Apply scaling
  return applyScaleFactorsL5L7(slcMasked);
}
```

### Nightlight harmonization

```{js, eval=FALSE}
// ===============================================================
// NIGHTLIGHT HARMONIZATION
// DMSP to VIIRS-like scale
// ===============================================================

function harmonizeDMSPtoVIIRS(dmspImage) {
  // Harmonization
  // Standard approach: polynomial transformation
  var dn = dmspImage.select('stable_lights');
  
  // Quadratic transformation (typical form from literature)
  // VIIRS_equiv = a + b*DMSP + c*DMSP^2
  var harmonized = dn
    .multiply(0.92)      // Linear coefficient
    .add(dn.pow(2).multiply(0.001))  // Quadratic term
    .add(0.5)            // Intercept
    .clamp(0, 65);
    
  return harmonized.rename('NIGHTLIGHT');
}

function getHarmonizedNightlight(year, regionOfInterest) {
  var nightlight;
  
  // Use 2013 as cutoff as 2012 is compromised
  if (year <= 2013) {
    var dmsp = DMSP_OLS
      .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(year, year, 'year'))
      .first();
      
    nightlight = dmsp ? harmonizeDMSPtoVIIRS(dmsp) : ee.Image.constant(0).rename('NIGHTLIGHT');
    
  } else {
    var startDate = ee.Date.fromYMD(year, 1, 1);
    var endDate = ee.Date.fromYMD(year, 12, 31);
    
    var viirs = VIIRS_DNB
      .filterDate(startDate, endDate)
      .filterBounds(regionOfInterest)
      .select(['avg_rad']);
      
    nightlight = viirs.size().gt(0) 
      ? viirs.median().rename('NIGHTLIGHT')
      : ee.Image.constant(0).rename('NIGHTLIGHT');
  }
  
  return nightlight.clip(regionOfInterest);
}
```

### Literature-endorsed spectral indices

```{js, eval=FALSE}
// ===============================================================
// LITERATURE-ENDORSED SPECTRAL INDICES
// ===============================================================

function addSpectralIndices(image) {
  // ========== VEGETATION ==========
  // NDVI - Tucker (1979) - vegetation presence/absence
  var ndvi = image.normalizedDifference(['NIR', 'RED']).rename('NDVI');
  
  // ========== WATER ==========
  // NDWI - McFeeters (1996) - water body detection
  var ndwi = image.normalizedDifference(['GREEN', 'NIR']).rename('NDWI');
  
  // MNDWI - Xu (2006) - better for turbid/urban water
  var mndwi = image.normalizedDifference(['GREEN', 'SWIR1']).rename('MNDWI');
  
  // AWEI_nsh - Feyisa et al. (2014) - water extraction (no shadow)
  var awei_nsh = image.expression(
    '4 * (GREEN - SWIR1) - (0.25 * NIR + 2.75 * SWIR2)',
    {'GREEN': image.select('GREEN'), 'SWIR1': image.select('SWIR1'),
     'NIR': image.select('NIR'), 'SWIR2': image.select('SWIR2')}
  ).rename('AWEI_NSH');
  
  // AWEI_sh - Feyisa et al. (2014) - water in shadow/dark areas
  var awei_sh = image.expression(
    'BLUE + 2.5 * GREEN - 1.5 * (NIR + SWIR1) - 0.25 * SWIR2',
    {'BLUE': image.select('BLUE'), 'GREEN': image.select('GREEN'),
     'NIR': image.select('NIR'), 'SWIR1': image.select('SWIR1'),
     'SWIR2': image.select('SWIR2')}
  ).rename('AWEI_SH');
  
  // ========== BARE SOIL / MINING ==========
  // BSI - Rikimaru et al. (2002) - bare soil detection
  var bsi = image.expression(
    '((SWIR1 + RED) - (NIR + BLUE)) / ((SWIR1 + RED) + (NIR + BLUE))',
    {'SWIR1': image.select('SWIR1'), 'RED': image.select('RED'),
     'NIR': image.select('NIR'), 'BLUE': image.select('BLUE')}
  ).rename('BSI');
  
  // NDBI - Zha et al. (2003) - built-up/disturbed land
  // Note: Often mislabeled as UI in literature
  var ndbi = image.normalizedDifference(['SWIR1', 'NIR']).rename('NDBI');
  
  // ========== GEOLOGICAL ==========
  // Iron Oxide Ratio - Segal (1982) - ferric minerals
  var ironOxide = image.select('RED')
    .divide(image.select('BLUE').max(0.0001))
    .rename('IRON_OXIDE');
  
  // Clay/Hydroxyl Index - Madeira (1991), also NBR2
  // Sensitive to clay minerals, crop residue, and burn scars
  var clayIndex = image.normalizedDifference(['SWIR1', 'SWIR2'])
    .rename('CLAY_INDEX');
  
  // ========== COLOR ==========
  // Coloration Index - Pouget et al. (1990) - soil color/iron
  // Note: Same formula as "Turbidity" for water
  var ci = image.normalizedDifference(['RED', 'GREEN']).rename('CI');
  
  // Brightness Index - Pouget et al. (1989) - soil brightness/salinity
  var bi = image.expression(
    'sqrt((BLUE*BLUE + GREEN*GREEN + RED*RED) / 3)',
    {'BLUE': image.select('BLUE'), 'GREEN': image.select('GREEN'),
     'RED': image.select('RED')}
  ).rename('BI');
  
  // ========== DERIVED ==========
  // Water probability composite
  var waterProb = awei_nsh.gt(0).and(awei_sh.gt(0))
    .multiply(2)
    .add(awei_nsh.gt(0).or(awei_sh.gt(0)))
    .rename('WATER_PROB');
  
  return image.addBands([
    ndvi, ndwi, mndwi, awei_nsh, awei_sh,
    bsi, ndbi, ironOxide, clayIndex, ci, bi, waterProb
  ]);
}
```

### Texture metrics

```{js, eval=FALSE}
// ===============================================================
// TEXTURE METRICS
// ===============================================================

function addTextureMetrics(image) {
  var nir = image.select('NIR');
  
  // Entropy
  var nirInt = nir.multiply(10000).toInt32();
  var entropy = nirInt.entropy(ee.Kernel.square(3)).rename('ENTROPY');
  
  // Standard deviation
  var stdDev = nir.reduceNeighborhood({
    reducer: ee.Reducer.stdDev(),
    kernel: ee.Kernel.square(3),
  }).rename('NIR_STD_DEV');
  
  // GLCM texture
  var nirByte = nir.multiply(255).toByte();
  var glcm = nirByte.glcmTexture({size: 3});
  var contrast = glcm.select('NIR_contrast');
  var correlation = glcm.select('NIR_corr');
  var variance = glcm.select('NIR_var');
  
  return image.addBands([entropy, stdDev, contrast, correlation, variance]);
}
```

### Topographic features (Farr et al. 2007)

```{js, eval=FALSE}
// ===============================================================
// TOPOGRAPHIC FEATURES - Farr et al. (2007)
// ===============================================================

function addTopographicFeatures(image, regionOfInterest) {
  var elevation = SRTM_ELEVATION.clip(regionOfInterest).rename('ELEVATION');
  var slope = ee.Terrain.slope(elevation).rename('SLOPE');
  var aspect = ee.Terrain.aspect(elevation).rename('ASPECT');
  
  // TRI - Terrain Ruggedness Index
  var tri = elevation.reduceNeighborhood({
    reducer: ee.Reducer.stdDev(),
    kernel: ee.Kernel.square(3),
  }).rename('TRI');
  
  return image.addBands([elevation, slope, aspect, tri]);
}
```

### Nightlight-derived features

```{js, eval=FALSE}
// ===============================================================
// NIGHTLIGHT-DERIVED FEATURES
// ===============================================================

function addNightlightFeatures(image, nightlight) {
  var nlNorm = nightlight.divide(50).clamp(0, 1).rename('NIGHTLIGHT_NORM');
  var isLit = nightlight.gt(0.5).rename('IS_LIT');
  
  var nlDensity = nightlight.reduceNeighborhood({
    reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
    kernel: ee.Kernel.circle(5),
  }).rename('NIGHTLIGHT_DENSITY');
  
  return image.addBands([nightlight, nlNorm, isLit, nlDensity]);
}
```

### Quality bands

```{js, eval=FALSE}
// ===============================================================
// QUALITY BANDS
// ===============================================================

function addQualityBands(image, collection, centerYear) {
  var count = collection.select('BLUE')
    .reduce(ee.Reducer.count())
    .rename('PIXEL_COUNT');
  
  var cloudProb = collection.select('BLUE')
    .reduce(ee.Reducer.stdDev())
    .rename('CLOUD_PROB');
  
  var sourceInfo = ee.Image.constant(centerYear).rename('COMPOSITE_YEAR');
  var dataMask = count.gt(0).rename('DATA_MASK');
  
  return image.addBands([count, cloudProb, sourceInfo, dataMask]);
}
```

### Get 3-year dry season collection

```{js, eval=FALSE}
// ===============================================================
// GET 3-YEAR DRY SEASON COLLECTION
// ===============================================================

function getThreeYearDrySeasonCollection(centerYear, regionOfInterest) {
  var mergedCollection = null;
  
  for (var year = centerYear - 1; year <= centerYear + 1; year++) {
    var dates = getDrySeasonDates(year);
    var yearCollection;
    var filterArea = ghanaGeometry;
    
    if (year <= 2003) {
      // Landsat 5 & 7 only
      var l5 = L5_COLLECTION
        .filterDate(dates.start, dates.end)
        .filterBounds(filterArea)
        .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', CONFIG.CLOUD_THRESHOLD))
        .map(maskCloudsL457Enhanced)
        .map(applyScaleFactorsL5L7);
        
      var l7 = L7_COLLECTION
        .filterDate(dates.start, dates.end)
        .filterBounds(filterArea)
        .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 50))
        .map(processL7);
        
      yearCollection = l5.merge(l7);
        
    } else if (year <= 2012) {
      var l5 = L5_COLLECTION
        .filterDate(dates.start, dates.end)
        .filterBounds(filterArea)
        .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', CONFIG.CLOUD_THRESHOLD))
        .map(maskCloudsL457Enhanced)
        .map(applyScaleFactorsL5L7);
        
      var l7 = L7_COLLECTION
        .filterDate(dates.start, dates.end)
        .filterBounds(filterArea)
        .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', CONFIG.CLOUD_THRESHOLD))
        .map(processL7); 
    
      yearCollection = l5.merge(l7);
      
    } else if (year <= 2021) {
      // Landsat 7 & 8 - HARMONIZE L8 to L7 reference
      var l7 = L7_COLLECTION
        .filterDate(dates.start, dates.end)
        .filterBounds(filterArea)
        .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', CONFIG.CLOUD_THRESHOLD))
        .map(processL7);
        
      var l8 = L8_COLLECTION
        .filterDate(dates.start, dates.end)
        .filterBounds(filterArea)
        .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', CONFIG.CLOUD_THRESHOLD))
        .map(maskCloudsL89Enhanced)
        .map(applyScaleFactorsL8L9)
        .map(harmonizeOLItoETM);  // ADDED: Cross-sensor harmonization
        
      yearCollection = l7.merge(l8);
      
    } else {
      // Landsat 8 & 9 - HARMONIZE both to L7 reference
      var l8 = L8_COLLECTION
        .filterDate(dates.start, dates.end)
        .filterBounds(filterArea)
        .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', CONFIG.CLOUD_THRESHOLD))
        .map(maskCloudsL89Enhanced)
        .map(applyScaleFactorsL8L9)
        .map(harmonizeOLItoETM);
        
      var l9 = L9_COLLECTION
        .filterDate(dates.start, dates.end)
        .filterBounds(filterArea)
        .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', CONFIG.CLOUD_THRESHOLD))
        .map(maskCloudsL89Enhanced)
        .map(applyScaleFactorsL8L9)
        .map(harmonizeOLItoETM);
        
      yearCollection = l8.merge(l9);
    }
    
    mergedCollection = mergedCollection === null 
      ? yearCollection 
      : mergedCollection.merge(yearCollection);
  }
  
  return mergedCollection;
}
```

### Create 3-year composite with medoid method

```{js, eval=FALSE}
// ===============================================================
// CREATE 3-YEAR COMPOSITE WITH MEDOID METHOD
// ===============================================================

function createThreeYearComposite(centerYear, regionOfInterest) {
  print('Processing 3-year composite centered on: ' + centerYear);
  
  var collection = getThreeYearDrySeasonCollection(centerYear, regionOfInterest);
  
  print('  Total images in 3-year window:', collection.size());
  
  // CORRECTED: Use MEDOID instead of percentile (Flood 2013)
  var bands = ['BLUE', 'GREEN', 'RED', 'NIR', 'SWIR1', 'SWIR2'];
  var baseComposite = calculateMedoid(collection, bands);
  
  // Add derived bands (literature-endorsed only)
  var withIndices = addSpectralIndices(baseComposite);
  var withTexture = addTextureMetrics(withIndices);
  var withTopo = addTopographicFeatures(withTexture, regionOfInterest);
  
  // Add harmonized nightlight
  var nightlight = getHarmonizedNightlight(centerYear, regionOfInterest);
  var composite = withTopo;
  composite = addNightlightFeatures(composite, nightlight);
  
  // Add quality bands
  composite = addQualityBands(composite, collection, centerYear);
  
  // Add temporal statistics
  var temporalStdDev = collection
    .select(['NIR', 'RED', 'SWIR1'])
    .reduce(ee.Reducer.stdDev())
    .rename(['NIR_STD_TEMPORAL', 'RED_STD_TEMPORAL', 'SWIR1_STD_TEMPORAL']);
  
  composite = composite.addBands(temporalStdDev);
  
  // Add valid pixel count for quality assessment
  var validPixelCount = addValidPixelCount(collection, bands);
  composite = composite.addBands(validPixelCount);
  
  // Add metadata
  composite = composite
    .set('center_year', centerYear)
    .set('year_range', (centerYear - 1) + '-' + (centerYear + 1))
    .set('buffer_km', CONFIG.BUFFER_KM)
    .set('composite_method', 'medoid_3year')
    .set('season', 'dry_extended')
    .set('cloud_threshold', CONFIG.CLOUD_THRESHOLD)
    .set('nightlight_sensor', centerYear <= 2012 ? 'DMSP_harmonized' : 'VIIRS')
    .set('cross_sensor_harmonization', 'Roy_et_al_2016')
    .set('system:time_start', ee.Date.fromYMD(centerYear, 1, 1).millis());
  
  return composite.clip(regionOfInterest).toFloat();
}
```

### NDVI baseline for anomaly calculation (2000–2004)

```{js, eval=FALSE}
// ===============================================================
// NDVI BASELINE FOR ANOMALY CALCULATION 2000-2004
// ===============================================================

function calculateNDVIBaseline(regionOfInterest) {
  var baselineYears = [2000, 2001, 2002, 2003, 2004];
  var baselineComposites = baselineYears.map(function(year) {
    return createThreeYearComposite(year, regionOfInterest).select('NDVI');
  });
  
  var baselineCollection = ee.ImageCollection.fromImages(baselineComposites);
  return baselineCollection.mean().rename('NDVI_BASELINE');
}

// Add NDVI anomaly to composite
function addNDVIAnomaly(composite, ndviBaseline) {
  var ndviAnomaly = composite.select('NDVI')
    .subtract(ndviBaseline)
    .rename('NDVI_ANOMALY');
  return composite.addBands(ndviAnomaly);
}
```

# Script 2: Training sample export (`02_export_training_samples.js`)

**Summary of the method**

Training points were placed by hand on the 2019 composite, with the RGB
composite as the primary reference. ESA WorldCover 2020 and NDVI were
displayed as visual aids only. Points were stratified into three zones by
distance to the 2019 mining polygons: inside the polygons (zone 1), 0–2 km
outside (zone 2) and 2–5 km outside (zone 3). The hand-placed geometries are
stored as Code Editor imports named `<Class>_<zone>` (for example `Water_1`);
the exported master CSV is the archived training dataset.

Recoding of classes is done in R

### Band naming correction

```{js, eval=FALSE}
// ===============================================================
// BAND NAMING CORRECTION
// ===============================================================
function ensureCompositeBands(image) {
  var spectralBands = [
    'BLUE', 'GREEN', 'RED', 'NIR', 'SWIR1', 'SWIR2', 
    'NDVI', 'BSI', 'NDWI', 'MNDWI', 'UI', 'MINING_INDEX'
  ];
  
  var bands = image.bandNames();
  
  if (bands.indexOf('NDVI').getInfo() !== -1) {
    return image;
  }
  
  var numBandsToRename = Math.min(bands.size().getInfo(), spectralBands.length);
  var originalBands = bands.slice(0, numBandsToRename);
  var newBands = spectralBands.slice(0, numBandsToRename);
  
  return image.select(originalBands, newBands);
}

composite2019 = ensureCompositeBands(composite2019);
```

### ESA WorldCover land-cover reference

```{js, eval=FALSE}
// ===============================================================
// ESA WORLDCOVER LANDCOVER CLASSIFICATION
// ===============================================================

var esaWorldCover = ee.ImageCollection("ESA/WorldCover/v100")
  .first()
  .clip(ghana);

// Define landcover classes and their codes
var LANDCOVER_CLASSES = {
  'Water': 1,
  'Dense_Forest': 2,
  'Woodland_Savanna': 3,
  'Urban': 4,
  'Bare_Soil': 5,
  'Agriculture': 6,
  'Other': 0
};

// Remap ESA WorldCover to my classification scheme
function remapWorldCover(worldCover) {
  return worldCover.remap(
    [10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 70, 80, 90, 95, 100], 
    [LANDCOVER_CLASSES.Dense_Forest,      // 10: Tree cover
     LANDCOVER_CLASSES.Woodland_Savanna,  // 20: Shrubland
     LANDCOVER_CLASSES.Woodland_Savanna,  // 30: Grassland
     LANDCOVER_CLASSES.Agriculture,       // 40: Cropland
     LANDCOVER_CLASSES.Urban,             // 50: Built-up
     LANDCOVER_CLASSES.Bare_Soil,         // 60: Bare/sparse vegetation
     LANDCOVER_CLASSES.Other,             // 70: Snow and ice
     LANDCOVER_CLASSES.Water,             // 80: Permanent water bodies
     LANDCOVER_CLASSES.Water,             // 90: Herbaceous wetland
     LANDCOVER_CLASSES.Dense_Forest,      // 95: Mangroves
     LANDCOVER_CLASSES.Other]             // 100: Moss and lichen
  ).rename('landcover');
}

var esaLandcover = remapWorldCover(esaWorldCover);
```

  1: 'Mining_Areas',
  2: 'Buffer_1_2km',

};

### Function to convert geometry to feature collection

```{js, eval=FALSE}
// ===============================================================
// FUNCTION TO CONVERT GEOMETRY TO FEATURE COLLECTION
// ===============================================================

function createSampleFeatureCollection(geometry, className, classCode, zone, notes) {
  if (!geometry) {
    print('Warning: Geometry for ' + className + '_' + zone + ' not found');
    return ee.FeatureCollection([]);
  }
  
  var features;
  
  // Check geometry type
  var geomType = geometry.type().getInfo();
  
  if (geomType === 'Point') {
    // Single point
    var coords = geometry.coordinates();
    features = [ee.Feature(geometry, {
      'longitude': coords.get(0),
      'latitude': coords.get(1),
      'class_name': className,
      'landcover_code': classCode,
      'zone': zone,
      'zone_name': ZONES[zone],
      'sampling_method': 'manual_geometry',
      'notes': notes || 'Manually sampled using GEE geometry tools',
      'verified': 'manual',
      'timestamp': Date.now()
    })];
  } else if (geomType === 'MultiPoint') {
    // MultiPoint - extract individual points
    var pointList = geometry.coordinates().getInfo(); // Get client-side coordinates
    features = pointList.map(function(coords) {
      // coords is now a client-side array [lon, lat]
      return ee.Feature(ee.Geometry.Point(coords), {
        'longitude': coords[0], // Use array indexing instead of .get()
        'latitude': coords[1],  // Use array indexing instead of .get()
        'class_name': className,
        'landcover_code': classCode,
        'zone': zone,
        'zone_name': ZONES[zone],
        'sampling_method': 'manual_geometry',
        'notes': notes || 'Manually sampled using GEE geometry tools',
        'verified': 'manual',
        'timestamp': Date.now()
      });
    });
  } else {
    print('Warning: ' + className + '_' + zone + ' is not a Point or MultiPoint geometry');
    return ee.FeatureCollection([]);
  }
  
  return ee.FeatureCollection(features);
}
```

### Export function (Drive and assets)

```{js, eval=FALSE}
// ===============================================================
// EXPORT FUNCTION FOR BOTH DRIVE AND ASSETS
// ===============================================================

function exportSampleCollection(featureCollection, className, zone, description) {
  if (featureCollection.size().getInfo() === 0) {
    print('No points to export for ' + description);
    return;
  }
  
  var timestamp = Date.now();
  
  // Export to Google Drive
  Export.table.toDrive({
    collection: featureCollection,
    description: 'Manual_' + className + '_Zone' + zone + '_Drive',
    fileFormat: 'CSV',
    folder: 'GEE_Manual_Sampling',
    selectors: [
      'longitude', 'latitude', 'zone', 'zone_name', 'landcover_code', 
      'class_name', 'sampling_method', 'notes', 'verified', 'timestamp'
    ]
  });
  
  // Export to GEE Assets
  Export.table.toAsset({
    collection: featureCollection,
    description: 'Manual_' + className + '_Zone' + zone + '_Asset',
    assetId: 'projects/XXX/assets/manual_samples_' + className.toLowerCase() + '_zone' + zone
  });
  
  print('Exports created for ' + description + ': ' + featureCollection.size().getInfo() + ' points');
  print('  - Drive: Manual_' + className + '_Zone' + zone + '_Drive');
  print('  - Asset: manual_samples_' + className.toLowerCase() + '_zone' + zone);
}
```

### Process all geometry collections by zone

```{js, eval=FALSE}
// ===============================================================
// PROCESS ALL GEOMETRY COLLECTIONS BY ZONE
// ===============================================================

// Function to safely get geometry (returns null if not exists)
function getGeometry(name) {
  try {
    return eval(name);
  } catch(e) {
    return null;
  }
}

// Process each zone
for (var zone = 1; zone <= 3; zone++) {
  print('=== PROCESSING ZONE ' + zone + ' (' + ZONES[zone] + ') ===');
  
  var zoneCollections = [];
  var zonePointCount = 0;
  
  // Process each landcover class for this zone
  Object.keys(LANDCOVER_CLASSES).forEach(function(className) {
    var classCode = LANDCOVER_CLASSES[className];
    var geometryName = className + '_' + zone;
    var geometry = getGeometry(geometryName);
    
    if (geometry) {
      var fc = createSampleFeatureCollection(
        geometry, 
        className, 
        classCode, 
        zone, 
        'Zone ' + zone + ' ' + className + ' samples'
      );
      
      var pointCount = fc.size().getInfo();
      if (pointCount > 0) {
        // Export individual class for this zone
        exportSampleCollection(fc, className, zone, className + ' Zone ' + zone);
        zoneCollections.push(fc);
        zonePointCount += pointCount;
        
        print('  ' + className + ': ' + pointCount + ' points');
      }
    } else {
      print('  ' + className + ': No geometry found (' + geometryName + ')');
    }
  });
  
  // Combine all classes for this zone and export
  if (zoneCollections.length > 0) {
    var zoneCombined = zoneCollections[0];
    for (var i = 1; i < zoneCollections.length; i++) {
      zoneCombined = zoneCombined.merge(zoneCollections[i]);
    }
    
    // Export combined zone collection
    Export.table.toDrive({
      collection: zoneCombined,
      description: 'Manual_All_Classes_Zone' + zone + '_Drive',
      fileFormat: 'CSV',
      folder: 'GEE_Manual_Sampling',
      selectors: [
        'longitude', 'latitude', 'zone', 'zone_name', 'landcover_code', 
        'class_name', 'sampling_method', 'notes', 'verified', 'timestamp'
      ]
    });
    
    Export.table.toAsset({
      collection: zoneCombined,
      description: 'Manual_All_Classes_Zone' + zone + '_Asset',
      assetId: 'projects/XXX/assets/manual_samples_all_zone' + zone
    });
    
    print('Zone ' + zone + ' Combined Export: ' + zonePointCount + ' total points');
    print('  - Drive: Manual_All_Classes_Zone' + zone + '_Drive');
    print('  - Asset: manual_samples_all_zone' + zone);
  } else {
    print('No points found for Zone ' + zone);
  }
  
  print('');
}
```

### Export all zones combined

```{js, eval=FALSE}
// ===============================================================
// EXPORT ALL ZONES COMBINED
// ===============================================================

print('=== CREATING MASTER EXPORT (ALL ZONES) ===');

var allZoneCollections = [];
var totalPointCount = 0;

// Collect all individual class collections across all zones
Object.keys(LANDCOVER_CLASSES).forEach(function(className) {
  var classCode = LANDCOVER_CLASSES[className];
  var classCollections = [];
  
  for (var zone = 1; zone <= 3; zone++) {
    var geometryName = className + '_' + zone;
    var geometry = getGeometry(geometryName);
    
    if (geometry) {
      var fc = createSampleFeatureCollection(
        geometry, 
        className, 
        classCode, 
        zone, 
        'Combined dataset - ' + className + ' Zone ' + zone
      );
      
      if (fc.size().getInfo() > 0) {
        classCollections.push(fc);
      }
    }
  }
  
  // Combine all zones for this class
  if (classCollections.length > 0) {
    var classCombined = classCollections[0];
    for (var i = 1; i < classCollections.length; i++) {
      classCombined = classCombined.merge(classCollections[i]);
    }
    
    allZoneCollections.push(classCombined);
    var classTotal = classCombined.size().getInfo();
    totalPointCount += classTotal;
    
    print(className + ' (all zones): ' + classTotal + ' points');
  }
});

// Create master combined collection
if (allZoneCollections.length > 0) {
  var masterCollection = allZoneCollections[0];
  for (var i = 1; i < allZoneCollections.length; i++) {
    masterCollection = masterCollection.merge(allZoneCollections[i]);
  }
  
  // Export master collection
  Export.table.toDrive({
    collection: masterCollection,
    description: 'Manual_Samples_Master_Dataset_Drive',
    fileFormat: 'CSV',
    folder: 'GEE_Manual_Sampling',
    selectors: [
      'longitude', 'latitude', 'zone', 'zone_name', 'landcover_code', 
      'class_name', 'sampling_method', 'notes', 'verified', 'timestamp'
    ]
  });
  
  Export.table.toAsset({
    collection: masterCollection,
    description: 'Manual_Samples_Master_Dataset_Asset',
    assetId: 'projects/XXX/assets/manual_samples_master_dataset'
  });
  
  print('');
  print('MASTER DATASET EXPORT CREATED:');
  print('Total points: ' + totalPointCount);
  print('  - Drive: Manual_Samples_Master_Dataset_Drive');
  print('  - Asset: manual_samples_master_dataset');
} else {
  print('No manual sample points found to export');
}
```
